mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( USER_ID, USER_PWD, USER_NAME, NICKNAME, PHONE, EMAIL, USER_ADDR, FULL_ADDR, ZIPCODE, ROLE, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pwd}, #{userName}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{userAddr}, #{fullAddr}, #{zipcode}, 'USER', NOW() )
